name: ps-battle-reader
description: Chrome extension that reads a Pokémon Showdown battle and recommends moves (reader, UI, engine, extension, and per-opponent profiles).

scripts.build: node scripts/build-learnsets.js && node scripts/make-icons.js && esbuild src/background/background.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=extension/dist/background.js && esbuild src/content/content.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=extension/dist/content.js && esbuild src/bridge/bridge.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=extension/dist/bridge.js && esbuild src/options/options.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=extension/dist/options.js && esbuild src/popup/popup.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=extension/dist/popup.js && esbuild src/ui/styles.css --outfile=extension/dist/content.css && esbuild src/options/options.css --outfile=extension/dist/options.css && esbuild demo/demo.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=demo/demo.bundle.js
